title: Keto-friendly Mexican Butter Stir-fry
description: A lazy Sunday dish featuring a creamy and buttery blend of mexican flavors with italian seasoning, perfect for keto diets.
instructions: Chop pork into small pieces and coat with Italian seasoning.
Place pork on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, add some olive oil and bake for 15 minutes until slightly golden brown.
Heat the butter in a pan over medium heat. Add eggplant slices to the pan and fry them until tender.
In another pan, melt coconut milk slowly, stirring occasionally, until it thickens into a creamy sauce.
Add pork pieces back into the pan with the fried eggplant and stir-fry together for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle keto breadcrumbs over the top of the dish to create a crispy topping.
Serve hot as a main course.
